The '''Viceroy of Bheriz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] leader of the [[Bherizian]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] and his people encountered both the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].
